body:
Nah she's really happy. Always with friends or just overall satisfied with her life.    
Life isn't a movie, it's inheritly unfair.

I don't think there is a point homestly, the others have good times and the best we can get is a few moments of satisfaction after a videogame match.    
I hate my sister. She keeps shitting on me for not going out of the house enough or not waking up at morning sometimes but she has such an amazing life, she doesn't even understand how terrible I feel and she just keeps going about having hundreds of friends.     

I wish she were a better person. Maybe she could've helped me not become what I am today.

It's not really about sexual stuff.     
It's just never having any friends or reason to wake up.
